locator-tweaks.config.option.bar_display:
Configures locator bar and experience bar integration:
• Default: standard vanilla behavior — displays experience bar when gaining XP, then restores markers
• Markers with Experience Bar: renders markers overlaid on the active experience bar
• Markers without Experience Bar: renders an empty bar without switching to experience
• Disabled: locator HUD and all markers are completely disabled
locator-tweaks.config.option.show_player: Enables or disables displaying other player markers on the navigation bar.
locator-tweaks.config.option.player_mark:
Configures player marker appearance or hides player markers on the navigation bar:
• Default (Square) — standard colored square markers
• Player Heads — renders player skin face miniatures
• Disabled — hides player markers from the navigation bar
